title: Implement Longest Common Subsequence length in Go using DP
description: Greenfield Go task: implement LCS(s1, s2 string) int that returns the length of the longest common subsequence of the two strings using bottom-up dynamic programming.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement LCS in lcs.go.

func LCS(s1, s2 string) int

Algorithm (bottom-up DP):
- Rune slices r1, r2 from s1, s2.
- dp[i][j] = LCS length of r1[:i] and r2[:j].
- dp[0][j] = 0, dp[i][0] = 0.
- if r1[i-1] == r2[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
- else: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
- Return dp[m][n].

All 5 tests in lcs_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
